name: aes_sbox_inplace_64and
detail: BDD path sum reached the normal form for all inputs and outcomes (60 measurements, 188 H, 124 HH, 0 omega; 32536 BDD nodes)
reference_how: copied from the development project; checked against an independent definition (AES tables)
wires: q[0..7] = x (bit i = coefficient of x^i, AES field GF(2^8)/x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1), q[8..15] = y, q[16..25] clean ancillas
note: |x,0> -> |0,S(x)>; 64 AND, 26 qubits (AND+measurement model; not directly comparable with Toffoli-model in-place results).
